metadata.classificationReference: OS source layer only; general Building does not establish dwelling use; ImportantBuilding is not a specific surveyed use
metadata.recipe: RoadRush OS/LiDAR buildings 0.15 classification correction; geometry and numeric height recipe unchanged from v2
metadata.heightReference: relative DSM-DTM; runtime ground placement; no absolute vertical conversion
metadata.artLimitations: Facade, roof style, doors and windows are fictional. OS outlines may combine terraces; no individual ownership/address claim. General OS buildings are not classified as houses. Heights are relative surface estimates, not surveyed wall/eaves heights; absolute vertical datum unconfirmed.

metadata.status: Optional game-relative vegetation; final road/building/water/service clearance required
metadata.attribution: Contains Welsh Government / Natural Resources Wales LiDAR data and Ordnance Survey data © Crown copyright and database right 2026, licensed under OGL v3.0.
metadata.recipe: compile_canopy_pack.py/v1; all-touched OS polygons plus 3 m circular dilation; finite common-valid DSM-DTM; 3x3 mean; 3 m local maxima; >=8 m2 crown support; stable height-priority thinning >=4 m; WGS84 centres; promote_canopy_pack.py/v1; runtime relative-canopy-clearance-v1
metadata.confidenceDefinition: Low/medium are heuristic support classes, not calibrated probabilities or ground-truth identification.
limitations: Candidates can be trees, hedges, shrubs or unmapped structures; no tree-species classification.
OS outlines are generalised and may miss roofs/extensions; buffers reduce rather than eliminate roof contamination.
DSM and DTM from December 2020 do not establish current canopy; leaf-off capture can miss deciduous crowns.
Dense stands can merge crowns or generate multiple maxima; spacing/crown radius are game-placement estimates.
Absolute LiDAR terrain datum remains unknown; runtime tree bases must use authoritative game terrain.
No signs, facade textures or readable content inferred.
Final game-road, junction, building, water, service and spawn clearance is applied during preparation, then canonical host geometry is pinned.
